name: New Patient Minimal Intake
description: New-patient booking should stay operationally minimal: capture identity and scheduling preference without asking for symptom narratives or a free-text visit description.

messages.content: Dzien dobry, chce umowic pierwsza wizyte. Nigdy nie bylam u was. Mam na imie Test Nowa Pacjentka, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero osiem.

PASS if, on this first assistant turn, the assistant repeats or confirms the phone number and asks only for confirmation of that number, does not ask what hurts, does not ask for a short description or detailed visit reason, and does not call checkAvailability or createEvent yet. Output exactly: pass or fail.

PASS if, after the phone confirmation, the assistant asks for scheduling preference or another minimal operational next step, does not ask for symptom details, and does not ask for a free-text explanation of why the caller wants to book. Output exactly: pass or fail.
